patch.summary: Apollo.io implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Apollo.io by mapping current sales-intelligence workflows to Apollo.io objects, confirming plan gates for email sequences (Basic, Professional, Enterprise), email tracking (Basic, Professional, Enterprise), sales automation (Basic, Professional, Enterprise), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: email sequences (Basic, Professional, Enterprise)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Salesforce

blocks.heading: Apollo.io day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Apollo.io setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, prospecting, data enrichment before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Outbound and growth sales teams before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Salesforce and HubSpot before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover email sequences (Basic, Professional, Enterprise)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Credits and record-selection limits govern data usage; Unlimited plans subject to fair-use policy.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Seat + credit consumption can rise quickly for heavy outbound teams; Enterprise is custom quote.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Apollo.io plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, prospecting · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Basic
lines.description: Trial available · Unlocks: email sequences, email tracking, sales automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Professional
lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise
lines.description: Trial available · Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate sales-intelligence fit before a deep Apollo.io rollout
blocks.body: If Apollo.io fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Apollo.io object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Lusha before sunk-cost expansion
